goal: Deliver the SDA-v1 draft for SDA-M05-L01 — Key-value and document stores

in_scope: Use the approved SDA-v1 outline and canonical backlog outputs for SDA-M05-L01.

**Prerequisites:** M04-L03

**Outcomes:** M05-L01-LO1: trace/model the mechanisms below in the worked scenario. M05-L01-LO2: choose and defend an alternative using the stated decision and failure criteria.

**Teaching sequence:**
1. Key-value operations, hash/ordered access and application-owned relationships.
2. Documents, nested aggregates, indexes and schema evolution.
3. Redis, Memcached, MongoDB and DynamoDB as distinct research cases; BASE is not a product guarantee.

**Worked-example plan:** Compare storing a session token with a product aggregate queried by attributes.

**Trade-offs and when to use/avoid:** Use key-value for known-key access; use documents when aggregate retrieval and indexed fields fit; verify transaction scope.

**Quick-check focus:** Explain why arbitrary attribute search changes a key-value design. The separate companion measures LO1 with Q1–Q3 and LO2 with Q4–Q6 plus EX-1; it will include explanations and an outcome map.
Teach the mapped topics PR-H108, PR-H110, PR-ARCH-MONGODB.
out_of_scope: Other milestones, workflow changes, merge and publication.

constraints: Coordinate ownership through GitHub Issue #73 on codex/drafts-sda-ms03.
Write original English for middle and senior engineers. Use the pinned Primer as a topic map and verify technical claims with exact primary sources.
Keep learner-facing status draft, separate teaching from assessment and label scenario assumptions.

definition_of_done.text: Record claim-level evidence at the canonical path with exact source sections, applicable versions and scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record and verify the primary source section, version or publication scope, and applicability for every material claim.
Teach every numbered outline item at M05-L01 with problem, mechanism, worked example, trade-offs, applicability and quick checks.
Keep draft; companion measures lesson-specific outcomes and includes explanations, rubric and explicit map.
Cover all assigned topic IDs; preserve the approved boundaries with adjacent lessons.
Trace the mechanism and failure behavior, ground decisions in stated evidence, and define the user-visible measurement population, window and threshold wherever the scenario uses an SLO.
